chunks: And Talhah ibn Zayd narrated from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father (peace be upon him), who said:

I read in the book of Ali (peace be upon him): 'If a man marries a woman and commits zina (unlawful sexual intercourse) with her before entering into her (consummation), she is not permissible to him because he is a zani (one who commits zina), and they are separated, and he gives her half of the dowry.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marriage if zina occurs before consummation?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated by Talhah ibn Zayd from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq quoting Imam Ali, establishes a specific fiqh ruling where pre-consummation zina dissolves the marriage bond (firqah) and mandates payment of half the dowry (sadaq). It highlights the Shia scholarly view that zina acts as a distinct impediment to marital continuity, separate from general divorce procedures, emphasizing the financial rights of the wife in this unique scenario.
